messages.subject: GGIR GitHub-only release 2.0-1
parts:
I have just created a GitHub-only release of GGIR. You can install this version of GGIR via the following commands:

install.packages("devtools")
library("devtools")
install_github("wadpac/GGIR")

next do:
packageVersion("GGIR")
to check that you are looking at version 2.0-1

Main updates are:
- GGIR is now able to read gzipped csv files
- Part 2 Fixed midnight selection being off by one sample when strategy = 2
- Part 1 tidied up metric calculation and added a few axis specific metrics
- Part 2 Added strategy 4 (ignore data before first midnight)
- Data from movisens accelerometers can be now processed (work done by Jairo)
- Part 5 timestamps in timeseries output in RData format (new since 2.0) now correctly accounts for timezone
- Part 4 now has option to only exclude the first or only the last night.

The plan is to include this in a new CRAN release sometime in July. So, please install this version and let us know if you encounter any problems.

Thanks,

Vincent
